candidate_change.kind: isolated exact rectangular height-graph diagnostic certifier
candidate_change.proposal: Use exact Fraction predicates over actual float64 coordinates to certify only a pair of closed rectangular height-graph solids. Complete all source checks first: upper/lower patch coverage, strict positive source thickness, side curtain coverage, and closed source topology. Only then evaluate candidate geometry relations or quality that can return FAIL. Accept actual NumPy ndarrays only; normalize ndarray subclasses to base views and verify actual shape, dtype, nbytes, and the 5,000-vertex/10,000-face caps before tolist(). Limit external domain/quality integer/Fraction numerator and denominator sizes to 2,048 bits; cap caller pair checks at 250,000; cap face-role tuple lengths by mesh face count before set/flatten work. These are input and pair-count limits only, not a formal bound on intermediate Fraction growth or total runtime. Retain matching coordinate_unit=mm/non-empty frame_id declarations as coordinate contract only; semantic geometry SHA does not authenticate source files or physical provenance. Unsupported premises and budget excess return UNKNOWN. Keep production disconnected.
acceptance_conditions: Both typed face partitions cover every source/candidate face exactly once.
Only true NumPy ndarrays are accepted; ndarray subclasses normalize to base view, and actual Nx3 shape, dtype, nbytes, and 5,000-vertex/10,000-face caps are checked before list conversion.
External domain/quality integers, Fractions, and finite floats are checked before conversion against a 2,048-bit numerator/denominator cap; caller pair budget has a hard 250,000 ceiling.
Source upper/lower coverage, strict positive thickness, complete side curtains, and closed topology all pass before candidate comparison or candidate quality can return FAIL.
Partition declares coordinate_unit=mm and a non-empty frame_id; source/candidate mesh metadata match that declaration without implying provenance authentication.
Upper and lower triangulations exactly cover one declared convex rectangular domain with no positive-area self-overlap; shared-vertex face pairs are included.
Different triangulations are overlaid using exact rational clipping and every generated overlay vertex is checked.
Fixed lower graph and boundary traces are equal; source and candidate thickness are strictly positive; candidate upper graph is no higher than source throughout the domain.
Every side face is assigned to exactly one rectangle side and the whole side curtain is validated by containment, overlap, and exact area coverage.
Both meshes pass closed-manifold, winding, positive-volume, and role-adjacency checks; candidate triangle quality limits are checked using exact squared rational predicates.
Resource limits are described only as input element, rational input size, and bbox candidate-pair limits; no formal intermediate Fraction/runtime bound is claimed.
PASS binds to exact source/result geometry-semantic hashes with the encoding disclosed; unsupported premises, malformed input, and budget exhaustion remain UNKNOWN.

Keep production integration, P03 wall-guard qualification, physical acceptance, observation capture, and detailed-label regeneration as separate decisions; measurement.valid must imply none of them.
